label: Docs spell-check
description: Weekly PR fixing typos and broken links in the docs.

automation.name: Docs spell-check
automation.prompt:
Proof-read the documentation in this repository and fix what is unambiguously wrong.

Scope: markdown files (`README.md`, `docs/**`, and any `*.md` at the top level). Skip generated files, changelogs, and vendored directories.

Fix only things that are objectively wrong:
- spelling mistakes and typos
- broken internal links (a relative link to a file that does not exist)
- code fences whose stated language is wrong or missing
- obviously stale references — a command, path, flag or filename that no longer exists in the repository. Verify with Grep before changing it.

Do NOT:
- rewrite prose for style, tone, or brevity
- reformat, re-wrap, or reorder anything
- touch technical terms, product names, or deliberate spellings you merely find unfamiliar — check them first
- change American/British spelling to match your preference

Open one pull request with all the fixes. In the description, group them by kind and state the count. If a change is a judgement call rather than a clear error, leave it out and mention it in the PR description instead.

If nothing needs fixing, open no PR and say so.
